newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks close up for sixth consecutive day.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks close up for sixth consecutive day.

text.p: Colombian stocks rose for the sixth consecutive day to their highest level for almost two years, led by leaps in bluechips, brokers said Friday.

Bogota's IBB index gained 3.85 percent to close at 947.13, its highest level since March 6, 1995, amid a 2.6 billion peso trade. Medellin's IBOMED general price index ended up 3.26 percent at 14,515.58, the highest level since September 29, 1995, amid a 802 million peso volume.
"We expected rises like this because of the new tax on bond earnings because bond investors move about 90 percent of the market," one Bogota broker said.
